notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed clipping issue on Tutorial
[*] Adjusted some platforms on 1-4 as they were more difficult than intended

[*] Fixed music playing when exiting a level on some of the levels
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who played DESCENT on launch!

There were some bugs and feedback that I received overnight and these are just some quick ones as more people play the game and give their reports and reviews.

[u][b]UI[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed Speed Counter and FPS Counter not showing/not saving your selection

[*] Fixed Quality Settings not working between levels

[*] Added song name graphic to each level
[/list]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Adjusted triggers on some levels that were skippable

[*] (Tried) Fixing the sides of platforms causing you to stick to them if you jumped into them
[/list]

[u][b]If any of you have feedback or bug reports for the game let me know through the forum post that I pinned![/b][/u]

[i][u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2755240/discussions/0/4692279782570423070/]Link to forum thread here[/url][/u][/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey everyone, just wanna start this announcement by giving a big thank you to everyone who has played, wishlisted, and overall supported DESCENT![/b][/h1]

This game has been in the works for years now as the basis of my independent game developing journey and seeing so many people try it out means a lot to me.

Now onto the update:

[list]
[*] Reworked the prologue level to make it in line with the rest of the levels, made it longer and more challenging.
[*] Added 1-2 to the game, may be rough around the edges but it will be updated.
[*] Some minor changes
[/list]

Let me know what you think! I'm always wanting feedback for every aspect of the game so feel free to reach out to me through things like Twitter and Discord, enjoy!
